description: Source code for the OAuth2Clients class in SuiteCRM, defining a CRM module for OAuth2 client management with properties and save logic.

classes.name: OAuth2Clients
classes.description: A class representing OAuth2 client records in SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean, with properties for client details and methods for saving and summarizing.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the OAuth2 client as its summary text.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to hash a new secret if provided and set duration values before saving.

methods.name: setDurationValue
methods.description: Sets the duration_value property based on request parameters, defaulting to 60 seconds if not specified.
